events.text: Germany’s Quantum Systems plans to supply Ukraine with tens of thousands of SPYS interceptor drones, jointly developed with Ukrainian company WIY. The interceptor is designed to counter Russian jet-powered Geran-4 and Geran-5 drones. Quantum Systems plans production of several thousand SPYS units per month, with initial deliveries possible this year. SPYS reaches 600 km/h, has a 15 km tactical radius and a maximum range of 30 km.

🔯 Mike Huckabee’s staff member suppressed criticism of Israel – report
David Milstein, the chief of staff of US Ambassador to Israel Huckabee, either diluted or outright blocked US embassy reports that were critical of Israel, an NYT investigation reveals.
Examples of Milstein’s meddling listed by the newspapers include:
🌏 A report criticizing an upsurge in the illegal Israeli settlement construction in the West Bank in March 2026 that never reached the US administration
🌏 Reports containing Israel Defense Forces concerns about the Israeli settler violence in the West Bank in April 2026 that could spark a Palestinian uprising, with Milstein instead praising PM Benjamin Netanyahu’s efforts to tackle settler violence
🌏 Detailed reports about the deaths of nine Palestinian Americans in the West Bank, requested by members of the US Congress, were blocked
Officials interviewed by the newspaper noted that Milstein sought to control all of the outgoing correspondence from the embassy related to the Palestinian matters.
The goal of Milstein’s actions apparently was to paint the Netanyahu government in a more favorable light to the Trump administration.
